reporting-org.narrative: Digital Impact Alliance at Capital For Good

description.narrative:
This program shapes global dialogue and practice by building political will, influencing norms, and creating trusted spaces for collaboration across governments, funders, multilaterals, and practitioners. The team ensures that global conversations on data governance, DPI, and trusted data sharing are informed by grounded country learning and responsive to local realities.
Through partnerships, convenings, and communities of practice — including DDX, ADLI, and other peer learning platforms — the team fosters exchange, alignment, and collective problem-solving across borders. The team also stewards some of DIAL’s outward-facing engagement channels, ensuring that insights, tools, and learning reach those who need them most.
What success looks like: Governments and ecosystem partners adopt and sustain people-centered policies, strategies, and institutional mechanisms that unlock trusted data sharing, with proven models and strengthened capacity enabling data to create measurable public value for more people.
Funds used to cover all activity costs under program
